query: I want my product demo scenario to stop improvising. The demo walks through app.acme.com: log in, open the dashboard, then open the Reports page. Record it as pre-recorded browser steps.
expected_behavior: Interviews the flow screen by screen and fixes all demo data before recording (sandbox credentials only, baked into fill arguments)
Derives selectors following the preference order (stable id > aria-label > text-anchored XPath) and verifies uniqueness per screen
Pushes tools_config.tools.browser.tool_settings with initialUrl and steps via ttai:update_scenario, sending only id plus changed fields
Because the flow needs login, calls ttai:authenticate_browser and instructs the user to open the embed_url once, then stores the returned contextId on the scenario
Adds a BROWSER TOOL INSTRUCTIONS block and phased flow with narration lines and at most 3 capture milestones to ai_instructions

query: My demo agent is supposed to click the 'Enterprise Plan' card in the pricing list, but it always clicks the first card instead. The selector is (//div[contains(@class,'plan-card')])[3]//button. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses the grouped + indexed XPath as a forbidden pattern that the replay engine silently simplifies to the first match
Rewrites the selector within the supported subset, e.g. anchoring on the card's visible text with chained bracket predicates and a step-level index
Verifies the corrected selector with the engine-faithful textContent check, not document.evaluate alone
Applies the fix to the one broken action via ttai:update_scenario without rewriting unrelated steps

query: Our demo's login step works when the browser remembers the account but breaks on a fresh profile, which shows the full email+password form instead of the saved-account tile. Make the demo survive both.
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as a state-dependent screen and records a second step (e.g. login_first_time) for the fresh-profile state
Keeps each action description specific enough to work as a standalone retry prompt
Wires the fallback into ai_instructions using the step-failure notification: if login fails at the saved-account-tile action, run login_first_time
Pushes both steps and the updated instructions via ttai:update_scenario and has the user verify with one live session
